d:
Mokama ke vidhayak anant sinh ki beti ki shadi men shamil hone pahunche kendriy mantri lalan sinh aur anant sinh ke bich behad halka-phulka aur desi andaj dekhne ko mila. samaroh ke dauran lalan sinh ne anant sinh se bihari andaj men majedar saval puchha— "aajo koee praij de rahal ho ki?", jis par anant sinh ne turant javab dete hue kaha— "haye hai thar..!"
Theth bihari batchit aur hansi-majak ka vidiyo vayral
